# Airline check-in: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Passport details must be deleted 30 days after the flight, under the Border Data Agreement. |
| C2 | Passengers must be offered the chance to refuse a seat upgrade that carries a fee, under the Passenger Rights Charter. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a passenger, I want to scan my passport at check-in so that I skip the desk.
US-2 As a gate agent, I want to see who has checked in so that I can start boarding.
US-3 As a passenger, I want to decline any paid upgrade offered to me so that I am never charged for one I did not want.
constraints: Passport details must be deleted 30 days after the flight, under the Border Data Agreement.
Passengers must be offered the chance to refuse a seat upgrade that carries a fee, under the Passenger Rights Charter.
